about: Which payload form each PHYSICAL collection stores. Read by cytir.index.payload_profile; a writer never infers it from a row, and an undeclared collection is refused. A collection is declared here when it is built, by a reviewed PR. Aliases (aw_prod) are not declared: writers resolve the alias to the physical name first. Every declared collection MUST carry a `sparse_rule` key (task 717): the BM25 prune rule it takes, or an explicit null for none; a declared collection without the key is refused by the drain, so a collection never takes raw sparse vectors by omission.

aw_e8.role: twin (the build box, :6457), raw payloads; retired from the serving box 2026-09-19; twin until 2026-10-16; kept read-only as the raw archive

aw_e9.role: prod (aw_prod alias since 2026-09-29T11:39Z), built by `cyt index build --from-collection` on PROD_E9 with --payload-profile normalized (task 637 S6, task 1256); retired from the serving box 2026-10-16T15:09Z; rollback copy on the scratch volume until A4
aw_e9.open_keys_why: consent_source is a per-host sentence: 31 values at the base build, 683 by the 2026-09-29 catch-up, and 198 new values in ONE pack (l1-backfill-batch-00002) after the flip. A closed key would refuse that pack. Known values are coded, unknown values are written raw; no writer assigns a code., section Unknown values.

sparse_rule.file: a sorted little-endian uint32 file, 231,105,100 bytes; its path is the operator setting sparse_rule_drop_terms (env AW_SPARSE_RULE_DROP_TERMS), never a default. Rebuild: python -m cytir.index.sparse_rule build-drop-terms --df <df-full.json> --out <file> --df-gt 0.02 --df-lt 2
sparse_rule.decided: task 717 (ruling 27, T3 Q1, Tim 2026-10-07): the drain writes prod under this rule; the twin (aw_e8) declares none and stays raw
